blocks.name: action
blocks.why: The companion produces prose plus __ACTION__...__END_ACTION__ delimited blocks parsed by the kask client. From the platform envelope's perspective this is narrative text: the companion is invoked via the workspace-message path (not the delegation hop), so envelope::build never runs and Gate::OutputSchema is never asked. The action block contract is enforced at the kask client layer using the kask-simops/2 app schema — six typed action types with JSON Schema validation on each. This sketch satisfies the Admission gate and records the domain and calibration signal for Loop 5; the authoritative typed contract for individual action blocks lives in apps/kask_simops.json.
